notes.title: Chapter 2 Update
notes.notes:
Chapter 2 is here! I hope you enjoy the MOOdy Chef! Here is what you can expect from the update

[list]
[*] New chapter with a bunch of crazy characters and puzzles to solve 
[*] 3 new boss characters 
[*] boss rush level. You can now replay bosses from both chapters
[*] 14 new achievements
[*] quality-of-life changes 1: We have removed the crafting boxes at the bottom of the Inventory UI. You can now just drag items onto each other
[*] quality-of-life changes 2: We changed the interaction options. Select the interactive item, and an interaction menu will appear above it.
[/list]

notes.title: Chapter 2 release date and info
notes.notes: [p]Hello again[/p][p]So, I promised to make an announcement soon on chapter 2, and here it is. Are you ready for it? Are you sure? It’s coming in red hot? Like this very moment? And that moment is NOW! Wait, that was too early… okay it’s now.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Chapter 2 update will come 22nd August![/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Here is what to expect from the update:[/p][list][*][p]The new chapter will contain a whole range of new characters and ridiculous moments to enjoy. We estimate that the run time will be around the same length as the first one.[/p][/*][*][p]3 new boss characters[/p][/*][*][p]A boss rush level. So, if you want to replay bosses from both chapters, you will now have a little room to choose whose butt you want to kick![/p][/*][*][p]14 new achievements[/p][/*][*][p]quality-of-life changes 1: We have removed the crafting boxes at the bottom of the Inventory UI. You can now just drag items onto each other, and if they are compatible with each other, they will combine.[/p][/*][*][p]quality-of-life changes 2: We changed the interaction options. Rather than scrolling to select your interaction, you just select the interactive item, an interaction menu will appear above it.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]I have been testing the game a number of times since july and all this month to try to get it as bug free as possible. So hopefully it will be all good when you get to try it out next Friday![/p]
